prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray (sunless) tan or UV tanning (tanning beds)? I can give a short list of highly rated local salons if you want me to look up current businesses and reviews — say which type and I’ll fetch up-to-date options.

Meanwhile, quick tips to help you choose the best tanning salon in Pleasanton:

- Pick the right type: spray/airbrush (safer, immediate results) vs. UV beds (higher skin‑cancer risk). Most pros recommend spray tans for safety.
- Check recent reviews (Google, Yelp, Facebook) and before/after photos.
- For spray tans: look for technicians who are certified, use quality DHA solutions (and offer shades), do a patch test, and show before/after pictures.
- For UV tanning: ensure beds are well‑maintained, staff do skin typing and session recommendations, and they offer eye protection and timers.
- Visit first: evaluate cleanliness, smell, staff professionalism, and whether they provide pre‑ and post‑tan instructions.
- Ask about pricing, packages (single vs. multi‑session), products used, and refund/retouch policies.

If you want, tell me which type you prefer and I’ll pull the top-rated salons in Pleasanton with addresses, hours, phone numbers, and highlight any specialties or recent customer feedback.
